summary: First-party discovery established an official national cadastral geoportal and local Shahrisabz/Qashqadaryo cadastral custody. The public geoportal route timed out during a bounded direct request, and no current JavaScript/configuration, service schema, CRS, safe parcel ID response or geometry could be inspected. No parcel absence is inferred.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Uzbek-language discovery queries are recorded in city-2710-shahrisabz.json. Results were limited to official or first-party government/cadastral sources.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Bounded direct request timed out after 20 seconds; no HTML, JavaScript configuration, API route, schema, CRS or feature response was retained. No TLS bypass was used.

Official directory page was available through public web retrieval; it lists Shahrisabz city and district cadastral custodians and the Qashqadaryo regional office. No parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the retrieved page.

Official manual was publicly retrievable; it documents map display and cadastral-number fields for land parcels, including a Shahrisabz district example. It is documentation, not a current city parcel API response.
Public official-agency information identifies Kadastr agentligi responsibilities and kadastr.uz as the official portal; no bounded parcel geometry response was obtained.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [39.0784844033024, 66.8474087070652] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate was shifted and no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
The E-IJARA manual example is for Shahrisabz district and does not prove citywide Shahrisabz coverage or current availability.
No current city boundary, parcel layer URL, public service schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity or citywide geometry coverage was verified.
A timeout or unavailable public viewer is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax, account or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; independent serial reviewer qualification remains required.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No current Shahrisabz parcel feature service was reached. The exact WUP point was preserved but no hit/miss inference was made.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National geoportal and local/regional cadastral custody; official documentation demonstrates parcel-map functionality in Shahrisabz district.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Custody and documentation only; anonymous Shahrisabz city parcel geometry was not verified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The current open.ngis.uz viewer configuration, API route, layer schema, CRS, native identity and citywide coverage remain unresolved because the bounded public request timed out. No claim is made about parcel absence, ownership, title, tax records or completeness of any Uzbek cadastral dataset.
